Definition: Abdon, the name of a place in Palestine and of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Abdon is both a place and a person — a Levitical city in Asher, given to the Gershonites, and Abdon the son of Hillel, who judged Israel eight years, had forty sons and thirty nephews who rode on seventy ass colts, and was buried in Pirathon. The name also belongs to a Benjamite in the genealogies.
TheologicalSignificance: Abdon judged Israel eight years and the Bible gives him three verses — a large family, a quiet tenure, an honourable burial. I believe that is a word for ordinary faithfulness: most of God's servants are not Samsons or Gideons, and their eight quiet years matter just as much.
